comment: I absolutely adore Dr. Ellis. It is a huge shame UR didn't offer her a tenure track position and force her to change schools. Dr. Ellis was incredibly enthusiastic and engaging, and she made what could have been a boring class super exciting.

Dr. Ellis is such a fun and caring professor. Her lectures are engaging and the only homework are short chapter quizzes about textbook content. No exams, just occasional short papers or presentations. Everyone does super well in this class, and it's clear everyone loves Dr. Ellis!
Dr. Ellis is great, and her classes are very manageable. Totally recommend this class for a GPA boost.

Dr. Ellis is young and relatable and I honestly love her. She doesn't make the class difficult, especially considering it's an intro class. She's super understanding and has extra credit throughout the semester. No final, but a final group presentation. I recommend her!
